# TerminalView: the command line

<!-- Generated by dist/sdk/gen-widget-docs.py from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

The terminal component and its port.

## `terminalview`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/terminalview.rs`)

`TerminalView`: the IYAKKI command line as a component an SDK app places in its layout (docs/development/UI-SDK.md, "Embedding the
terminal"). The app keeps a `TerminalView` in its state, gives it a [`TerminalPort`] (the core's) and a base action number, and a rectangle
to draw in. The view owns what is on screen: the lines typed and printed, the field, the person's yes/no card. It draws through [`Canvas`]
in the monospace style, so it works in the shell, in a browser or client and as a WASM tile.

What the app does:
```text
event(Tick):   term.tick()                                      (opens the session once)
event(Action): if term.owns(a) { term.action(a) }   event(Key): if term.key(k) { return }   event(Text): term.text(t)
view:          term.draw(c, th, &metrics, rect)     leaving: term.close()
```
A line that changes something does not run: the core asks, the view shows "Allow" and "Deny" (keys `y` and `n`; Esc denies), and the answer goes back to the core. The view never runs anything itself.

## `terminal`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/terminal.rs`)

The terminal port: what an SDK app is handed so that it can embed a command line (see [`crate::terminalview::TerminalView`]). The port is
the core's `Terminal` facet seen from the app: one session of the IYAKKI command line, checked by the person's policy; a line that
changes something comes back with a question the person must answer (the core asks, the app only shows the card). [`MemTerminal`] is the
in-memory port for tests and the browser preview, following the same rules.

### struct `MemTerminal`

An in-memory terminal: a read-only command (`echo`, `pwd`, `ls`, `clear`, `whoami`) answers; anything else asks first and, when
allowed, answers `done: <line>`. Lines run are kept in `ran`.

```rust
pub struct MemTerminal
```

Public fields:

- `pub ran: VecDeque<String>`
